messages:
Alex: CI is red on macos-sim after the toolchain image roll. Seeing a bunch of undefined symbols and missing framework headers when building the iOS simulator target. Filing here in case someone sees a quick fix.

BuildBot: [CI] macos-sim //apps/myapp:unit_tests — FAILURE
  ERROR: /workspace/apps/myapp/BUILD:42:10: Linking of rule '//apps/myapp:myapp_sim' failed (Exit 1)
  /usr/bin/ld: framework not found XCTest
  clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
  
  See: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345/log

Maria: ack. Was anything pinned in the bazel toolchain yesterday?

Alex: Not that I know of — infra rolled the clang/SDK image (gcr.io/redwood/toolchains/macos:2024-09-18). PR: infra/rolls#1272

Cheng: The image roll updated Xcode SDK layout. Bazel toolchain's apple_sdk_home might be pointing to /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/iPhoneSimulator.platform/Developer/SDKs, but in the new image it's under /opt/xcode/.. now. Could be why framework search fails.

Sam: Can you paste the failing link command?

Alex: Pasting the relevant bits: ```
/opt/host/bin/clang -isysroot /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/iPhoneSimulator.platform/Developer/SDKs/iPhoneSimulator16.4.sdk -F/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/iPhoneSimulator.platform/Developer/SDKs/iPhoneSimulator16.4.sdk/System/Library/Frameworks -o bazel-out/darwin-fastbuild/bin/apps/myapp/myapp_sim ... -framework XCTest
```

Cheng: If the SDK path the compiler uses doesn't exist in the image, clang will still run but ld will fail to find frameworks. Try `xcrun --show-sdk-path` in the image. Also check `apple_sdk_home` in the toolchain config.

Jen: We hit this during the last toolchain roll too. Short-term: pin the previous toolchain image to unblock CI (infra can rollback the image tag). Long-term: update the apple toolchain rules to detect SDK location via xcrun.

Maria: Can someone bisect the infra/rolls PRs to the last green? If it's the image roll then revert or add a compatibility symlink in the image.

Alex: Starting a quick bisect: `git log --oneline infra/toolchains | sed -n '1,40p'` and will invoke the CI rerun for each roll. If anyone has a faster local repro command for the sim target that would help.

Sam: Local repro: `bazel build //apps/myapp:myapp_sim --config=macos_sim --sandbox_debug --spawn_strategy=local` inside the macos-toolchain container. If you run in the new image you'll hit it quickly.

BuildBot: @Alex re-run requested: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345/retry (queued) :hourglass: 

Alex: Rerun finished — same failure. Confirmed the SDK path in the image is `/opt/xcode/SDKs/iPhoneSimulator16.4.sdk` (no /Applications Xcode symlink).

Cheng: Two quick options: 1) Create a compat symlink at /Applications/Xcode.app -> /opt/xcode in the container image (fast fix). 2) Update Bazel apple toolchain macro to call `xcrun --show-sdk-path` and use that path (more correct).

Jen: Infra can push the symlink now to unblock tests. I'll open infra/rolls#1273 to patch the image. Alex, once infra pushes, please request CI rerun.

Alex: Thanks. I added label `infra-bisect` and pinged infra. Also added a short note to the failing PR: "macos toolchain image moved SDK layout; linking fails for simulator targets — planning compat symlink revert."

Maria: Triage-wise, marking as P0 (blocking CI). If infra can't get the image out in 30m we'll pin the previous image in the bazelrc for the CI job.

BuildBot: infra image update pushed (image: gcr.io/redwood/toolchains/macos:2024-09-18-patch1) — rolling out :rocket:

Sam: After image patch, locally verified `ls /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/iPhoneSimulator.platform/Developer/SDKs` exists.

Alex: CI rerun after patch queued.

BuildBot: [CI] macos-sim //apps/myapp:unit_tests — SUCCESS 

Alex: ✅ Tests green. Thanks everyone. Closing the bisect thread. Infra: please add a note to the roll changelog about SDK path change and recommended follow-ups for toolchains.

Jen: Filed infra/rolls#1274 with follow-up tasks: update toolchain macros and add CI smoke that builds an iOS simulator target during toolchain roll.

Maria: Nice work — extra points for the quick symlink strategy. :thumbsup:

Cheng: Will follow up with a small PR to make apple SDK detection robust in our rules.

Alex: Closing thread.
